name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: Drop the advisory REVIEW state from the default happy path: the shipped close-the-loop route now goes VERIFY OK -> GATE directly (the REVIEW state + its REVIEW OK -> GATE / REVIEW EMPTY -> PERSIST edges are gone), because with work_own_filings on a REVIEW-in-route loop files ~one finding per loop-authored PR that re-enters as the next tick's backlog, so it self-feeds and never converges. The drop is DATA-READY (GATE reads verdicts/gate_results, INTEGRATE reads ONLY verdicts; neither consumes REVIEW's review_findings), so VERIFY -> GATE resolves + validates via adapter_wiring.build_loop with no data-readiness break. REVIEW is dropped ONLY from the default route's states+edges; its machinery (make_review, DEFAULT_ADAPTER_MAP['REVIEW'], AGENT_PORT_TEMPLATES['REVIEW'], REVIEW_FINDINGS_KEY + the seeded-empty review_findings + REPORT flush) stays available-but-unused so a project MAY re-add REVIEW via its own route.json override. The embedded conservative DEFAULT_ROUTE (the read-and-idle spine) already omits REVIEW; the shipped default-config/route.json is updated in lockstep by a separate packaging-config release. feature.json advanced 0.52.0 -> 0.53.0.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md was already advanced to 0.53.0 (drop REVIEW from DEFAULT_ROUTE; VERIFY OK -> GATE) by the dispatcher's spec-update commit 47a73e8 before this TDD cycle; this cycle implements + tests that spec in scheduling scope
